authority.user_instruction: Add independently verifiable portable evidence and real recovery behavior one bounded unit at a time without changing the approved manifest authority, machine CLI, Docker trust boundary, or evidence-state semantics.

scope.objective: Freeze and implement append-only, content-addressed portable receipts; durable idempotent event history; state-separated interruption recovery; verified PostgreSQL backup and clean restore; and an independent offline verifier on the already verified local topology.
forbidden_work: Changing the approved product promise, manifest authority, Docker trust boundary, or evidence semantics
Mounting a Docker or container-engine socket into any container
Giving containers secrets, privileged mode, host network, broad host mounts, or external runtime network
Creating or changing a real workflow approval or executing repository workflow input
Deleting, mounting into a new project, relabeling, renaming, or otherwise mutating any protected IS-0003 evidence volume
Using a dependency before its exact source, integrity, license, vulnerability, and compatibility gate passes
Adding dashboard, registry publication, image redistribution, release, cloud, Kubernetes, multi-tenancy, or arbitrary remote execution work
Claiming tests, source inspection, a live database alone, or a later successful attempt overwrites prior evidence
reversible_actions: Create closed schemas, fixtures, canonicalization vectors, locks, mutation harnesses, ADRs, and documentation
Implement host-owned portable receipt custody and an offline verifier using source-gated dependencies or the standard library
Extend the stable CLI with additive evidence and recovery commands that preserve existing command and exit semantics
Use only fixed non-sensitive disposable staging, containers, networks, and volumes for destructive recovery probes
Create and verify PostgreSQL dumps and restores in bounded disposable custody
Retain immutable failed, invalid, cancelled, stale, superseded, and corrupted attempts
Commit and push verified bounded improvements
stop_conditions: A required change would alter the core promise, trust boundary, approval authority, or weaken an explicit security or evidence gate
A dependency or artifact cannot pass the applicable source, integrity, license, vulnerability, or compatibility gate
A recovery probe cannot prove that every protected volume remains untouched
A test would require a secret, real sensitive data, consequential action, paid service, access or ownership change, or irreversible operation
An evidence state cannot remain distinguishable and independently verifiable
A checkpoint or release claim cannot be verified from clean local and public custody

units.purpose: Freeze the portable receipt, artifact, event-chain, run-summary, custody, canonicalization, and offline-verification contracts with valid, invalid, corruption, truncation, reordering, replay, and state-separation vectors before implementation.
inputs: Frozen CLI and run-event v1 contract

exit_condition_delta.rationale: The contract must fail closed under bounded mutations before any receipt writer or verifier is trusted.

units.purpose: Implement an atomic append-only portable receipt store and an independent offline verifier that requires no Docker, PostgreSQL, network, approval state, secret, or repository write access.

exit_condition_delta.rationale: A portable receipt is not trusted until clean custody and a separate read-only verifier reject corruption.

units.purpose: Persist monotonic append-only run events with deterministic idempotency keys, duplicate replay handling, and explicit stale and superseded transitions while preserving every prior attempt.
inputs: Verified receipt store and offline verifier

exit_condition_delta.rationale: Duplicate and superseding attempts must be observable without rewriting the earlier event chain.

units.purpose: Add host crash reconciliation and durable cancellation/failure recovery at bounded boundaries, proving that lifecycle failure never fabricates or erases a verification verdict.

exit_condition_delta.rationale: The real host and disposable topology must recover without mutating protected evidence or collapsing lifecycle and verdict.

units.purpose: Create an exact PostgreSQL logical backup from bounded disposable evidence state, restore into a clean disposable volume, and verify schema, roles, event ordering, receipts, and negative privilege boundaries.
outputs: Restored evidence equivalence and privilege evidence

exit_condition_delta.rationale: Backup existence is insufficient; an exact clean restore must reproduce the bounded evidence state and least-privilege controls.

units.purpose: Run the integrated receipt and recovery matrix repeatedly against the real CLI, disposable Compose topology, PostgreSQL, both runners, corruption cases, interruption boundaries, and clean restore.

exit_condition_delta.rationale: Integrated PASS requires repeated real-surface behavior, mutation rejection, recovery, and complete disposable teardown.

units.purpose: Commit, push, credential-free clean-clone, replay, tag, and independently verify the bounded IS-0004 checkpoint without claiming dashboard or release completion.
outputs: Public receipt and recovery checkpoint receipt

exit_condition_delta.rationale: The milestone closes only after exact public custody reproduces its real receipt and recovery claims and independently verifies the annotated marker.

required_checks: Closed-schema and canonicalization validation with fail-closed mutations
Independent offline verification of exact receipts and artifacts
Truncation, reordering, replay, duplicate, corruption, stale, and superseded cases
Real cancellation, failure, host-crash, resume, orphan, and cleanup behavior
Exact PostgreSQL dump, clean restore, data equivalence, role, and privilege checks
Protected-volume identity before and after every destructive probe
Repeated real CLI, Compose, database, Python, and Node recovery matrix
Credential-free clean-clone, Git integrity, secret scan, and public marker verification

handoff.current_checkpoint: IS-0004 active from verified checkpoint-is-0003; workflow approval remains MISSING and execution remains unavailable
handoff.next_action: Execute IS4-U01 by freezing closed portable receipt and event-chain contracts plus fail-closed vectors without writing runtime evidence or starting Docker.
do_not_carry_forward: Do not alter or automate operator approval
Do not execute repository workflow input
Do not mount Docker authority into containers
Do not add secrets, external runtime network, broad mounts, or privileged execution
Do not touch the three protected IS-0003 evidence volumes
Do not collapse verdict and lifecycle state or overwrite prior attempts
Do not claim dashboard, redistribution, registry, release, or v0.1.0 completion
